<script>
/* Category filter enhancement, scoped to this page -- it is the only
   listing on the site. Quarto's own markup is a bare `<div onclick>`, with
   no keyboard access; this adds that, plus a collapsible "+N more" row
   below 768px. Progressive enhancement: the CSS default (see styles.css)
   is every chip visible and wrapped, fully functional with no JS. This
   only prunes it down to a compact row once it runs. */
(function () {
  function enhanceCategories() {
    var sidebar = document.getElementById('quarto-margin-sidebar');
    if (!sidebar) return;
    var row = sidebar.querySelector('.quarto-listing-category');
    if (!row) return;
    var chips = Array.prototype.slice.call(row.querySelectorAll('.category'));
    if (!chips.length) return;

    chips.forEach(function (chip) {
      chip.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      chip.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      chip.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          chip.click();
        }
      });
    });

    var moreBtn = null;
    var expanded = false;

    function collapse() {
      if (expanded) return;
      chips.forEach(function (c) { c.style.display = ''; });
      if (moreBtn) { moreBtn.remove(); moreBtn = null; }

      if (window.innerWidth >= 768) return;

      moreBtn = document.createElement('button');
      moreBtn.type = 'button';
      moreBtn.className = 'chip-more';
      moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      row.appendChild(moreBtn);
      var btnWidth = moreBtn.getBoundingClientRect().width;

      var available = row.clientWidth;
      var used = 0, visible = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
        var w = chips[i].getBoundingClientRect().width + 8;
        if (used + w + btnWidth > available && visible > 0) break;
        used += w;
        visible++;
      }
      var hiddenCount = chips.length - visible;
      if (hiddenCount <= 0) {
        moreBtn.remove();
        moreBtn = null;
        return;
      }
      for (var j = visible; j < chips.length; j++) chips[j].style.display = 'none';
      moreBtn.textContent = '+' + hiddenCount + ' more';
      moreBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        expanded = true;
        chips.forEach(function (c) { c.style.display = ''; });
        moreBtn.remove();
        moreBtn = null;
      });
    }

    collapse();
    var resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(collapse, 150);
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enhanceCategories);
  } else {
    enhanceCategories();
  }
})();
</script>
